label: Synthetic — a missed period that a one-off outflow would have carried, resolved by the named arbiter
provenance: SYNTHETIC. The fact pattern is the recurring one in Delaware earnout litigation (buyer-controlled cost allocation in a measurement period); every figure is invented to exercise the harness. No practitioner clause is reproduced here.

dispute.reasoning: The 30M outflow was a group restructuring charge allocated into the target entity after closing; excluded for the purpose of the period test.

settled.note: SYNTHETIC: the parties settled the full tranche after the arbiter excluded the allocated charge.
